title: `expect hash stable` — the only dedicated guard for the blessed frozen tails — is parsed but never enforced
evidence:
harness/demo.odin:118
	expect_hash_stable: bool,
harness/demo.odin:249-251
		case "expect":
			if len(fields) >= 3 && fields[1] == "hash" && fields[2] == "stable" {
				d.expect_hash_stable = true
chunk goldens/health_lose.t1:
454 b25974f8de6c0ea9
455 b25974f8de6c0ea9
...
480 b25974f8de6c0ea9
chunk goldens/health_win.t1:
3002 477a3d0bac62881f
...
3040 477a3d0bac62881f
(grep 'hash_stable' over the whole repo returns ONLY the two lines above — the field is set and never read)
detail: Both new manifests bless post-terminal frozen tails — the E17 barrier's observable. The demos request `expect hash stable`, but nothing enforces it: a `harness save` after a barrier regression would silently bless a non-frozen tail and still pass.
recommended_fix: Enforce it: in run_demo, after the tick loop, when expect_hash_stable is set and the run went terminal, fail loudly unless the trailing hashes are all identical.

detail: The win demo never breaches (meter pinned at 100), and the lose demo drains to 0 with no recovery window — so recharge (+1/tick), grace refill (5/50), and E30 exit never fire. Regressions there leave all blessed T1/T2 bytes identical.
recommended_fix: Add a recovery demo (breach → fix → meter recharges, grace refills) with captures, or bless a T1 for the no-soft-lock recovery scenario so the recovery paths have a golden pin.

title: Goldens digest states health_lose.t1 'ticks ~460' but the blessed manifest header says 'ticks 480'
evidence:
goldens-digest.md:25
- goldens/health_lose.t1 — NEW manifest: same header shape, ticks ~460. (Run_Lost when the meter empties ~tick 452.)
chunk goldens/health_lose.t1:
+# t1 manifest — per-tick FNV-1a-64 state hashes (full sim state)
+ticks 480
+452 6e725dc7035ec506
+453 b25974f8de6c0ea9
...
+480 b25974f8de6c0ea9
detail: The digest's lose tick count (~460) contradicts the manifest (480 = 24000ms × 20 Hz). Any mechanical check trusting the digest would mis-expect the manifest length; the manifest is the authoritative artifact.
recommended_fix: Correct the digest to say ticks 480 (27 post-terminal frozen ticks, 453-480).
